params.resolver: Address of resolver that timed out

recordAppealBond(uint256,address,address.details: V1 implementations should revertSHOULD only be callable by the escrow contract or resolution module (enforced by implementation)For ETH bonds (token == address(0)): MUST be payable and require(msg.value == amount)      For ETH bonds, depositor MUST equal escalatedBy (user-funded)For ERC20 bonds: Implementation MUST pull tokens via safeTransferFrom(depositor, address(this), amount)      and MUST revert on transfer failure. Depositor is typically the escrow contract (escrow-funded),      but escalatedBy tracks the actual escalator for metrics/accounting.

params.depositor: Address that deposited bond (for ERC20: escrow contract, for ETH: user/escalator)
params.escalatedBy: Address that initiated the escalation (always the user/escalator)
